title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 16: What the Storm Left

planning.voiceReason: Urgent inspection tests Jon’s impulse to rush.
planning.earlyCare: Jon notices Min rubbing his cold hands and offers a break.
planning.desire: Reopen the centre quickly after checking the water protection.
planning.obstacle: Jon confuses a quick glance at the roof with a safe inspection.
planning.dramaticChange: Jon accepts An’s stop and separates genuine progress from false reassurance.
planning.sourceBoundary: After the storm, Jon wants a quick all-clear so the community can resume daily life. An directs a ground-level inspection; the water protection holds, but the learning centre's roof and furniture need work. Jon stops treating speed as proof of competence. They agree to reopen the centre only after trained inspection and repair.
sceneActivities: Jon inspects ground-level pipe; An remains seated; Min records. At school no entering damaged zone; team returns to safe meeting point.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain practical questions; open hand at a boundary, quiet attention afterward.
actingSignature.An: Specific limits and short questions; supported seated rest while reviewing, no assumed healing.
actingSignature.Min: Urgent explanations soften into admitting uncertainty; rests attentive when corrected.
actingSignature.Mother: Concrete requests and accurate accounting; no presumed forgiveness or renewed station shift.
actingSignature.Sela: Patient concrete questions; does not reach for private report. Quiet open posture and attentive gaze.
actingSignature.Ivo: Begins with explanations and permissions; shifts to asking his son. Guarded hands, then release into attentive rest.

planning.listenerTurn: An says Jon need not show he can fix everything; listener Jonathan, then one separate nod and restraint entry.
planning.payoff: Protection inspected and holding; no stock changed. Learning-centre roof visibly unstable, remains closed. Qualified repair/inspection arranged; safe interim meeting space available, teacher Sela invited to plan temporary lessons.
planning.freshQuestion: Can families return to safe temporary classes while trained repairs are organized?
